pages.text: It appears you've found a way to create a violent horse-like steed made from Illagers instead of Villagers. Unlike Ravagers, these steeds appeared ready to be mounted out of the gate.
Much like camels, pressing jump will charge up their dash, allowing you to manually charge at your foes.
Tramplers can be part of a $(l:goetied:mutations/illager_servants)raiding party$(), though they cannot be leaders.
